name: Jumping
desc: With a running start of at least 10 feet, your long jump distance in feet equals your Strength score; a standing long jump covers half that. For a high jump with a running start, you leap a number of feet equal to 3 + your Strength modifier; a standing high jump covers half that. In either case, each foot cleared costs a foot of movement. The GM may call for a Strength (Athletics) check to clear an unusually difficult jump.
